name: OmaShield
author: hogar1977
description: Interactive, scanner-guarded AUR updates and installs for Omarchy. Preselect every pending update, defer or deselect any of them, and only let the packages you greenlit past the aur-scan + yay-guard review. Requires aur-scanner and yay-guard. Use the bar widget to flip it on/off.

barWidget.description: Toggle interactive, scanner-guarded AUR updates and installs.
